title: Hardening, Baselines, and Drift
description: A Mermaid causal-loop diagram of the configuration-hardening feedback cycle — CIS benchmarks seed a baseline, configuration management enforces it, drift detection finds gaps, and findings revise the baseline — with new vulnerabilities and auditors as outside influences.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Explain the continuous loop among baselines, configuration management, and drift detection.
Identify how outside influences (new vulnerabilities, auditors) force the baseline to evolve.
prerequisites: What system hardening and a configuration baseline are

instructionalStrategies: Trace the clockwise cycle, then add each outside influence and ask what it changes.
Discuss why Drift Detection is highlighted as the focus of ongoing operational attention.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why can a hardening baseline never be considered finished?
When drift is detected, what three responses are possible, and how do you choose among them?
